subsystems.name: Active polymer
subsystems.role: deforms when voltage is applied, converting electrical energy into mechanical strain.

subsystems.name: Compliant electrodes
subsystems.role: deliver charge uniformly across the polymer without restricting its movement.

subsystems.name: Encapsulation and electrolyte
subsystems.role: keeps ions mobile in ionic EAPs and protects the actuator from moisture and dust.

subsystems.name: Mechanical frame and pre-strain
subsystems.role: holds the polymer under tension to boost strain and directs the motion.

subsystems.name: Drive electronics
subsystems.role: supplies the required voltage and controls actuation.

buildSteps.title: Form the polymer film
buildSteps.detail: Cast or spin-coat a thin elastomer or polymer membrane to a precise thickness.

buildSteps.title: Pre-strain the film
buildSteps.detail: Stretch the film biaxially and fix it to a frame; pre-strain increases strain and breakdown strength.

buildSteps.title: Apply compliant electrodes
buildSteps.detail: Spray, print or brush conductive material onto both faces of the film.

buildSteps.title: Stack or roll layers
buildSteps.detail: Combine multiple layers to multiply force and displacement.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the mechanical frame
buildSteps.detail: Attach the active stack to a frame, hinges or a spring that shapes the output motion.

buildSteps.title: Encapsulate and seal
buildSteps.detail: Coat the actuator to keep out moisture and, for ionic types, retain the electrolyte.

buildSteps.title: Connect drive electronics
buildSteps.detail: Wire the electrodes to the power supply and control system.

buildSteps.title: Test and characterize
buildSteps.detail: Measure strain, force, speed and lifetime, and iterate.

prerequisites.tech: Dielectric elastomers with high breakdown strength
prerequisites.why: they must withstand kilovolt driving voltages without failing.
electrodes must stretch with the polymer without cracking or adding stiffness.
portable prosthetics need compact converters for dielectric elastomers.
ionic EAPs operate at low voltage but dry out or degrade over time.
their response is nonlinear and changes with load and environment.
hand-built prototypes have not been translated into high-volume processes.

pathway.milestone: lab and niche prototypes (soft grippers, haptic displays) demonstrate useful motion
pathway.unlocks: proof of concept in prosthetics and delicate assembly.

pathway.milestone: materials with longer lifetime and higher force density
pathway.unlocks: integration into wearable and prosthetic devices.

pathway.milestone: multilayer stacks with integrated sensing and closed-loop control
pathway.unlocks: precise, gentle manipulation in assembly and robotics.

pathway.milestone: mass-manufactured artificial muscles that match natural muscle
pathway.unlocks: humanoid robots and advanced prosthetics with soft, safe actuation.
